transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I suppose... I've just been feeling off lately. I wake up with this heavy, hollow sadness. It's like... the studio lights are on, but there's no music in me anymore. I just don't know what to do about it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... I guess it's been a while. The... the down part, anyway. Probably about nine months. Give or take.
Do you find yourself still enjoying activities that you used to like before this period of feeling off started?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess I haven't paid much attention to that. I just sort of... do what I have to do every day.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure or enjoyment in?
No, not really. I just... I don't feel much of anything when I try to do things. It's just going through the motions.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah... I suppose so. I just don't really care about much right now.
Do you feel anxious or on edge most of the time?
Um... I don't know. I guess I don't really feel... much of anything, honestly. Not really anxious, just... flat, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?

Um... yeah, I guess. My rehearsal clothes have been hanging a bit looser than usual. I just... when I was buzzing with ideas a while ago, I'd skip meals without really noticing. And now... I don't know. Food just tastes like cardboard anyway, so... yeah.
Do you feel like you've been moving more slowly than usual?
Um... yeah. I suppose. Even just... crossing the studio to pick up my notebook feels... slowed down. Like my body is moving through wet sand, I guess. Instead of music. It's just... hard.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to live or of harming yourself?
Um... no. I haven't... thought about anything like that. I just... I don't really have the energy for much of anything right now, honestly. But... no.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by feeling like your body is moving through wet sand?

I don't really know how else to explain it, honestly. It's just... heavy. Like I said, just walking across the floor to grab my notebook... it takes so much effort. Usually, moving is just... natural for me. Like music. But lately, every step just... drags. I'm just really slow right now. That's all.
Is the slowness you're experiencing just physical, or do you also feel like your thoughts are moving slower than usual?
Um... I don't know. I haven't really... noticed anything with my thoughts, I guess. It's mostly just... my body. Just feeling heavy.
Do you ever feel restless or like you need to move around when you're feeling down?
No. I just... mostly just want to stay still. I don't really have the urge to move at all.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past nine months?

Um... yeah, I guess so. My rehearsal clothes are definitely... hanging a bit looser. When I was, you know, buzzing with all those ideas a while back, I'd just... skip meals. Didn't even notice. And now... I don't know, food just tastes like cardboard anyway. So... yeah, I've lost some weight.
Do you feel like you're able to experience any kind of pleasure at all, even if it's just for a brief moment?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think so. Everything's just kind of... flat.
Do you feel worse in the morning?
Um... I don't know. I haven't really... paid attention to that. It's just kind of bad all day, I guess.
Do you feel like you're able to concentrate or make decisions as well as you used to?
Um... no, not really. It's... it's hard to focus on anything. I just... I can't seem to think straight enough to decide anything right now.
Would you say that you're still able to carry out your daily routines and responsibilities, even if you don't enjoy them?

Um... I guess I'm still showing up for the essentials. But... no, not really. I... I fell behind on my teaching prep. And I missed a grant deadline. Things at the studio just got kind of... chaotic. The people I collaborate with actually had to start handling my basic scheduling for me. I'm just... not functioning like I normally do.
Do you feel like your depression is consistently worse, or are there times when it feels a bit better?
Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't... I haven't really noticed it changing much. It just sort of... stays like this, mostly.
Are there any days when you feel slightly better than others?
Um... no. Not that I've noticed. Like I said, it just... it all kind of feels the same every day.
Do you feel like your depression is interfering with your ability to work or take care of things at home?

Um... yeah. I mean, kind of like I was saying a minute ago... it's definitely affecting my work. Missing that grant deadline and... needing my collaborators to handle my scheduling for me. I'm just... not functioning the way I usually do as a choreographer right now. So... yes.
